notes.title: Drone Strike: Engineer Simulator is now in Early Access
notes.content:
Hey everyone, it’s finally here! Today, we launched Drone Strike: Engineer Simulator in Early Access!

Dive into a world of tactics, drones, and explosions. This is just the beginning, and we truly care about what you think. Let us know what you like and what we can improve — together, we’ll make the game even better.

Thanks for being with us. Let’s keep flying!

notes.title: Early Access on November 21
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Tomorrow, November 21, we’re launching Drone Strike: Engineer Simulator in Early Access! 🎉 Here’s what’s waiting for you in the game:

- Drone flights with exciting combat and civilian missions.
- Drone customization: weapons, styles, and colors.
- Creativity and strategy — choose your tactics or go all out with destruction!
- We’re kicking off Early Access to make the game better with your help. Your feedback means the world to us! 

Get ready, we’re starting tomorrow! Thank you for your support, and see you in the game!

notes.title: Get Ready for Launch!
notes.content:
Hello, gamers of the world!

[b]Drone Strike: Engineer Simulator[/b] is coming soon! Step into the role of a drone engineer, design powerful combat drones, and dominate the battlefield with tactical precision.

Add [b]Drone Strike: Engineer Simulator[/b] to your wishlist now and be among the first to play at launch!
